skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — combine all clips into one video with smooth transitions — and get merged...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Video Editor Combine Clips.
- Merge multiple video clips into a single seamless video with AI-powered transitions.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Simple authentication with free 7-day token and 100 credits.
- Fast cloud rendering (30–90 seconds per job), with easy file upload and download.
- Automatic session management and clear error reporting for common issues.
